summary: Pretty serialization emits unnecessary parent table headers, such as [profile] before [profile.dev]. The fix marks tables implicit so the encoder omits headers for tables containing only nested tables. The fix-added regression test is error_includes_key in tests/pretty.rs and requires the easy feature. Both reversal regions occur exactly once; the reversal restores the exact parent implementation. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: assert_eq!(raw, pretty) fails because pretty contains an extra [profile] header before [profile.dev].
